## Professional Summary

Alfredo Di Tullio is a multidisciplinary professional who has built a career across five distinct fields: dentistry, software development, gastronomy, philosophy, and tourism. Born and raised in Argentina, he trained as a dentist at the Universidad Nacional de La Plata (UNLP, graduated 2013) and practiced clinically for several years. He then embarked on an international culinary career, spending six years cooking in professional kitchens across Denmark, Norway, Spain, and Australia, including a stint at a Michelin-starred restaurant.

While abroad, he pursued academic studies in philosophy (B.A. from Universidad TECH, 2023) and tourism (University Technician from UNTREF, 2024). He authored two books exploring philosophy, meaning, and travel, and in 2026 published "Inteligencia Artificial para Odontólogos", a guide to AI in the dental clinic written by a dentist for dentists. In 2020, he began teaching himself software development and now builds full-stack web applications, with his flagship project being DentalCore — a comprehensive clinical platform for dentistry.

He is currently based in Melbourne, Australia. He is a licensed dentist (M.N. 40.973), is completing a Master's in Artificial Intelligence applied to Dentistry, and is a member of the Red de Científicos Argentinos en Australia (RCAA).

His central work is DentalCore, the first rule-based Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for primary-care dentistry in Latin America, of which he is founder and creator. He is both the researcher who published its design (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20821942) and the developer who built it — a dentist who writes the clinical software he uses.

## Software Projects

### DentalCore (dentalcore.app)
- **Type:** Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for dentistry
- **Status:** Active development (MVP)
- **URL:** https://dentalcore.app
- **Portfolio page:** https://www.alfredoditullio.com/projects/dentalcore
- **Stack:** React 19, TypeScript, Vite 6, Supabase (Auth, PostgreSQL, Storage, Edge Functions), Zustand (20 domain stores), Tailwind CSS, Google Gemini 2.0 Flash AI
- **Key features:**
  - Digital odontogram with 47 finding codes
  - AI-powered clinical diagnostics (14 specialized prompts via Gemini)
  - Treatment planning with inference engine
  - Periodontogram and periodontal charting
  - Endodontics, surgery, orthodontics, and whitening modules
  - Practice management (appointments, patients, agenda)
  - Financial tools (payments, cashbox, insurance billing)
  - Patient portal (mobile-first, magic link auth)
  - Lab portal for dental laboratory orders
  - Marketing tools (campaigns, leads, segmentation)
  - Inventory management
  - Audit logging (INFO/SUCCESS/WARNING/CRITICAL)
  - Multi-tenancy via RLS with clinic_id
  - Smile Designer (AI-powered via Replicate)
  - Voice commands (Web Speech API, es-AR, Rustpotter wake word)
  - Legal compliance: Ley 26.529 (Argentina) — consent templates, immutable evolution notes
- **Architecture:** Component → useStore() → Zustand store → Repository → Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **Testing:** Vitest (unit) + Playwright (E2E, 15 specs)
- **Routes:** 60+ routes via React Router v7

## Books

### Inteligencia Artificial para Odontólogos (2026)
- **Language:** Spanish
- **Theme:** Artificial intelligence in dentistry
- **URL:** https://www.alfredoditullio.com/books/inteligencia-artificial-para-odontologos
- **Subtitle:** Una guía para comprender, usar y cuestionar la inteligencia artificial en el consultorio
- **Description:** A guide written by a dentist for dentists, in the language spoken in the clinic rather than at technology conferences. It gives the profession the vocabulary to reason about AI — machine learning, LLMs, RAG, hallucination, clinical decision support, algorithmic bias — each explained with a dental example. Sixteen chapters covering detection vs. diagnosis, trust and hallucinations, image-assisted diagnosis, clinical decision support systems, privacy and patient data, how to evaluate an AI tool, liability, bias and consent, AI ethics in healthcare, and the dentist's changing role.
- **Notable:** the author discloses throughout that he builds dental software (DentalCore), using it as one worked example among others rather than as a sales pitch.

### En búsqueda del sentido (2023)
- **Language:** Spanish
- **Theme:** Philosophy, meaning, identity, purpose
- **Description:** A philosophical exploration of meaning, identity and purpose through the lens of travel and lived experience. The book examines how crossing borders — physical and intellectual — shapes our understanding of ourselves and the world.

### Horizontes Infinitos (2025)
- **Language:** Spanish
- **Theme:** Philosophy, travel, reflection
- **Description:** Philosophy, travel and reflection — a journey through infinite horizons of thought and geography. The second book expands on the author's travels and philosophical investigations, weaving together narratives from multiple countries and disciplines.
- **Press coverage:** Featured in Veu Catalana (2025) with a book launch event

## Academic Publications

### DentalCore: Design and Implementation of a Rule-Based Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) for Primary-Care Dentistry in Latin America
- **Type:** Preprint (Open Access)
- **Published:** June 2026, Zenodo
- **DOI:** 10.5281/zenodo.20821942
- **URL:** https://zenodo.org/records/20821942
- **ORCID:** https://orcid.org/0009-0008-7398-9549
- **License:** CC BY 4.0
- **Abstract:** Describes a rule-based clinical decision support system for dentistry in resource-limited Latin American settings. Features three specialized inference engines: treatment planning from clinical data, medical-risk assessment prior to procedures, and drug interaction checking. Meets all four Kawamoto criteria for CDSS effectiveness. Demonstrates strong specificity without over-alerting on low-risk cases.
- **Keywords:** Clinical decision support systems, dental informatics, rule-based systems, primary care, Latin America, digital health, CDSS, dentistry
